content.short: SpinUp is a Hyperliquid DeFi hub built around mHYPE liquid staking and a token launchpad.
content.description: SpinUp issues mHYPE as a liquid staking token on Hyperliquid and pairs it with a launchpad for new tokens, so the staking yield and the speculative side of the chain sit in one product. Bundling the two is common on young chains, where the same users tend to do both.
content.meta: mHYPE liquid staking paired with a launchpad, covering both sides of a young chain.
